# LiveFlow v0.2.3 - Table of Contents

Interactive node-based flow diagrams for Phoenix LiveView.
A library for building visual node editors, workflow builders,
and interactive diagrams similar to React Flow, but for LiveView.

## Pages

- [LiveFlow](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

- Guides
  - [Getting Started with LiveFlow](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/getting-started.md)
  - [Custom Node Types](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/custom-nodes.md)
  - [Real-Time Collaboration](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/collaboration.md)
  - [Themes](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/themes.md)

## Modules

- [LiveFlow](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.md): LiveFlow - A Phoenix LiveView library for building interactive node-based diagrams.
- [LiveFlow.Types](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Types.md): Type definitions for LiveFlow.

- Core Data Structures
  - [LiveFlow.Edge](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Edge.md): Edge data structure for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.Handle](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Handle.md): Handle data structure for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.Node](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Node.md): Node data structure for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.State](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.State.md): Main state container for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.Viewport](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Viewport.md): Viewport data structure for LiveFlow.

- Components
  - [LiveFlow.Components.Edge](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Components.Edge.md): Edge function component for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.Components.Flow](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Components.Flow.md): Main Flow LiveComponent for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.Components.Handle](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Components.Handle.md): Handle function component for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.Components.Marker](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Components.Marker.md): Dynamic SVG marker definitions for LiveFlow edges.
  - [LiveFlow.Components.NodeWrapper](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Components.NodeWrapper.md): Node wrapper LiveComponent for LiveFlow.

- Path Algorithms
  - [LiveFlow.Paths.Bezier](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Paths.Bezier.md): Bezier curve path calculation for edges.
  - [LiveFlow.Paths.Path](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Paths.Path.md): Behaviour for edge path calculations.
  - [LiveFlow.Paths.Smoothstep](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Paths.Smoothstep.md): Smoothstep path calculation for edges.
  - [LiveFlow.Paths.Step](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Paths.Step.md): Step/orthogonal path calculation for edges.
  - [LiveFlow.Paths.Straight](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Paths.Straight.md): Straight line path calculation for edges.

- Features
  - [LiveFlow.Clipboard](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Clipboard.md): Copy/paste clipboard for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.History](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.History.md): Undo/redo history stack for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.Layout](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Layout.md): Helpers for preparing flow data for client-side auto-layout (ELK).

  - [LiveFlow.Serializer](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Serializer.md): Serializes and deserializes LiveFlow state to/from JSON.
  - [LiveFlow.Validation](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Validation.md): Connection validation functions for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.Validation.Connection](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Validation.Connection.md): Helper to validate and create edges from `lf:connect_end` event params.

- Collaboration
  - [LiveFlow.Collaboration](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Collaboration.md): Real-time collaboration support for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.Collaboration.User](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Collaboration.User.md): Represents a user in a collaborative flow session.

- Change Tracking
  - [LiveFlow.Changes.EdgeChange](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Changes.EdgeChange.md): Edge change event types for LiveFlow.
  - [LiveFlow.Changes.NodeChange](https://live-flow.hexdocs.pm/LiveFlow.Changes.NodeChange.md): Node change event types for LiveFlow.
